mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 325.0 indicates persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain or increase interest rates, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 325.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strong employment growth (PAYEMS rising >0.5%) and declining unemployment (UNRATE falling >0.1pp) signal an overheating labor market that generates wage inflation, prompting monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth >0.5% and UNRATE decline >0.1pp, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, rising housing starts (HOUST > 1450.0) indicate sustained consumer and business confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1450.0 and economy is in late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A level of INDPRO above 100.0 indicates robust manufacturing activity and supply chain strength, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 100.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP level above 24000 billion dollars (current value 24065.956) indicates robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 > 24000, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) reflects a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is low, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A retail sales level above 730,000 million dollars (current value 733,537.0) indicates strong consumer spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 730000, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
